digest.component_or_area: LLM fallback chain and tracing instrumentation
propositions: Fallback candidate attempts must each emit exactly one rebar OTel span with zero-based order, provider-qualified model identity, outcome from {returned, raised}, and optional provider usage, without duplicating the outer Agent model-request span.
Candidate spans must nest as children of the single Agent model-request span via ambient OTel context, verified by parent-span-id assertions and confirmed by a SPIKE before implementation.
Error reasons on raised candidate spans must be sanitized through sanitize_diagnostic and contain no prompt, response, credential, endpoint, or unsanitized exception body.

The existing ordered FallbackExceptionGroup, S2-preserved bug-895c native-to-prompted fallback, RunUsage, pricing, and _pai_structured control flow must remain identical and unchanged by candidate instrumentation.
Span emission or exporter failures while tracing is enabled must be swallowed at the wrapper boundary so the fallback result, RunUsage, and propagated exception are identical to tracing-off.
Candidate instrumentation must work with the base install without tracing extra imports and produce no span dependency errors when tracing is disabled.
